raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Top-edge load coordinate",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The arrow locates the load near the middle of the top edge, but no exact horizontal coordinate is given.",
      "readings": [
        "Top-edge node at x = 29L/64, approximately matching the drawn position",
        "Top-edge midpoint at x = L/2"
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4.6, Fig. 6(a): the square has side L, but the load position has no coordinate or dimension."
    },
    {
      "category": "support_type",
      "entity": "Displacement components constrained on the left edge",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The triangular support symbols do not explicitly identify the constrained displacement components.",
      "readings": [
        "Fix both in-plane displacement components at every left-edge node",
        "Fix horizontal displacement along the left edge and fix vertical displacement only at the lower-left node"
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4.6, Fig. 6(a): repeated hollow triangles mark the left edge without displacement labels; the Fig. 10 caption describes such markers only as constrained boundary supports."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Single downward force magnitude",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The downward force has no specified magnitude or normalization.",
      "readings": [
        "Force magnitude 1 in consistent force units",
        "Force magnitude 10 in the same force units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Fig. 6(a) shows an unlabeled downward arrow; Sec. 4.6 reports compliance values without specifying the force magnitude."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Young's modulus",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No numerical elastic modulus or stiffness normalization is supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "E = 1 in normalized stress units",
        "E = 10 in the same stress units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.1, Eqs. (1)–(3), introduces K without numerical material properties; Sec. 4.6 provides no case-specific modulus."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The isotropic elastic Poisson ratio is unspecified.",
      "readings": [
        "Poisson's ratio = 0.25",
        "Poisson's ratio = 0.30"
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Secs. 3.1, 4.2 and 4.6 describe FEA and compliance evaluation without specifying Poisson's ratio."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The in-plane formulation does not establish whether plane stress or plane strain is used.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Fig. 6 presents a two-dimensional square; Sec. 3.1 and Appendix F specify equilibrium and in-plane stresses without identifying the constitutive reduction."
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness or unit-depth convention is specified for the two-dimensional compliance calculation.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness t = 1 in consistent length units",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.1 in the same length units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Fig. 6(a) specifies only the two in-plane dimensions L; Secs. 3.1 and 4.6 give no thickness normalization."
    }
  ]
}
